repos.name: nestjs-prisma-starter

repos.name: golang-gin-realworld

repos.name: create-t3-turbo

repos.name: chi

repos.name: django
repos.note: Large repo (> 5k files) for scan time and memory; also stresses per-rule caps. BSD-3-Clause. skip_links: the archive has symlinks under docs/_theme (doc icons), skipped and never created.

repos.name: spring-boot-realworld
repos.note: RealWorld (Conduit) backend in Spring Boot (REST controllers, Spring Security JWT, MyBatis); no release tags, pinned to a commit. MIT.

repos.name: aspnetcore-realworld
repos.note: RealWorld (Conduit) backend in ASP.NET Core (controllers, JWT [Authorize], EF Core); no release tags, pinned to a commit. MIT.

repos.name: homeland
repos.note: Homeland, the Ruby China community forum (Rails app with Devise auth, API, admin namespace); no release tags, pinned to a commit. MIT. Chosen over gothinkster/rails-realworld-example-app, which has no license.

repos.name: laravel-realworld
repos.note: RealWorld (Conduit) backend in Laravel (api routes, JWT auth middleware, Eloquent). MIT.

repos.name: example-voting-app
repos.note: Docker's multi-service sample (Flask vote, Express result, .NET worker, Redis, Postgres) with plain Kubernetes manifests in k8s-specifications/ (no probes, no limits) and Compose files; pinned to a commit. Measures k8s-no-probes, k8s-no-limits and unvalidated-body. Apache-2.0.

repos.name: robot-shop
repos.note: Instana's polyglot multi-service shop (Express cart/catalogue/user, Flask payment, Go dispatch, Java shipping, PHP ratings, nginx web) with Kubernetes, OpenShift and Swarm descriptors; archived upstream, pinned to the last commit. Measures list-route-no-pagination (inline Express handlers returning find({})), docker-latest-tag and k8s-no-probes. Apache-2.0.

repos.name: awesome-compose
repos.note: Docker's collection of about 40 small Compose stacks (Flask, FastAPI, Express, Go, Spring, ASP.NET, React front ends) in one repository: the monorepo of the growth set, one folder per stack. Measures ci-no-test-step (its only workflow is CodeQL) and unvalidated-body. CC0-1.0 (public-domain dedication).

repos.name: todo-nodejs-mongo
repos.note: Azure Developer CLI sample: Express + Mongoose API documented by a committed openapi.yaml, React web app, Bicep infra, deploy-only GitHub workflow; pinned to a commit. Measures openapi-drift (routers mounted under prefixes in another file), unvalidated-body and ci-no-test-step. MIT.

coverage_note: coverage: rule -> corpus repos whose scan produces at least one signal of the rule (scanner 1.1.0 development tree, 2026-11-05; `run_precision.py sample` warns when it drifts). unmeasured: rules no corpus repo triggers, with the reason. Every registered rule is in exactly one of the two.

unmeasured.mixed-error-shapes: No permissive candidate tried so far mixes incompatible 4xx/5xx body shapes inside its route files (checked: the 18 corpus repos, gin-gonic/examples, open-telemetry/opentelemetry-demo, Azure-Samples/todo-python-mongo, ThreeDotsLabs/wild-workouts-go-ddd-example, eddycjy/go-gin-example). Most services centralise errors in one handler, which the rule does not read by design.
unmeasured.retry-no-backoff: No corpus repo or tried candidate (same list as mixed-error-shapes) has a retry/attempt loop around a recognised network call without sleep or backoff; retries in these repos use client libraries (async.retry with an interval, urllib3 Retry) or sleep between attempts. Needs a repo found by code search, which the corpus tooling does not do.
